arguments.query: select booking_id,status,message,path,duration_ms from request_logs where service="booking" and status>=400 order by rowid desc limit 8
select booking_id,idempotency_key,state from charges where booking_id in ("bkg_8d1fda601e865e56b0cb391a0e94bc4d","bkg_1d55d18e23cc54dfbbfc050928cef175")

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) c from bookings b where status!="confirmed" or booking_id in (select booking_id from outbox)
select service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=500 order by rowid desc limit 8
select rowid,service,path,status,message from request_logs where status>=400 order by rowid desc limit 12

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") cc,(select group_concat(amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) amts,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b where b.status="confirmed" and (cc!=1 or h!=1 or k!=1 or amts!=cast(b.amount_cents as text)) union all select flight_id,"cap",capacity,(select count(*) from holds h where h.flight_id=f.flight_id),0,fare_cents,0,0 from flights f

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") cc,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b where b.status="confirmed" and (cc!=1 or h!=1 or k!=1)
